import java.awt.Color;
import java.awt.Graphics2D;
import java.awt.image.BufferedImage;
import java.io.ByteArrayInputStream;
import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
import java.io.File;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.nio.file.Paths;
import java.util.Arrays;

import javax.imageio.ImageIO;

import net.coobird.thumbnailator.*;
import net.coobird.thumbnailator.builders.*;
import net.coobird.thumbnailator.filters.*;
import net.coobird.thumbnailator.geometry.*;
import net.coobird.thumbnailator.makers.*;
import net.coobird.thumbnailator.name.*;
import net.coobird.thumbnailator.resizers.*;
import net.coobird.thumbnailator.resizers.configurations.*;
import net.coobird.thumbnailator.tasks.*;
import net.coobird.thumbnailator.tasks.io.*;
import net.coobird.thumbnailator.util.*;
import net.coobird.thumbnailator.util.exif.*;

public final class ApiTest {
    private ApiTest() {}

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        try {
            String grid_png = "/Users/clockorangezoe/Documents/phd_projects/code/geoAI/GRAIL_thumbnailator_B2/experiments/external/thumbnailator/source/src/test/resources/Thumbnailator/grid.png";
    String grid_jpeg = "/Users/clockorangezoe/Documents/phd_projects/code/geoAI/GRAIL_thumbnailator_B2/experiments/external/thumbnailator/source/src/test/resources/Thumbnailator/grid.jpg";
    String exif_jpeg = "/Users/clockorangezoe/Documents/phd_projects/code/geoAI/GRAIL_thumbnailator_B2/experiments/external/thumbnailator/source/src/test/resources/Exif/original.jpg";
    String output_dir = "/Users/clockorangezoe/Documents/phd_projects/code/geoAI/GRAIL_thumbnailator_B2/experiments/external/thumbnailator/.aideal_exec/B2/output";

    // pre-loaded typed inputs (comprehension.execute.preamble)
    BufferedImage sourceImage = new BufferedImage(32, 24, BufferedImage.TYPE_INT_RGB);
    Graphics2D graphics = sourceImage.createGraphics();
    graphics.setColor(Color.BLUE);
    graphics.fillRect(0, 0, 32, 24);
    graphics.setColor(Color.YELLOW);
    graphics.fillRect(8, 6, 16, 12);
    graphics.dispose();
    BufferedImage destinationImage = new BufferedImage(16, 12, BufferedImage.TYPE_INT_RGB);
    ByteArrayOutputStream imageBytes = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
    Path outputPath = Paths.get(output_dir, "thumbnail.png");
    Files.createDirectories(outputPath.getParent());

            // TODO API_TEST_START
            net.coobird.thumbnailator.ThumbnailParameter param = null;
            try {
                // ThumbnailParameter is required to instantiate a ThumbnailTask, but its constructor 
                // signature varies across versions. We use reflection to safely instantiate it.
                java.lang.reflect.Constructor<?>[] constructors = net.coobird.thumbnailator.ThumbnailParameter.class.getDeclaredConstructors();
                java.lang.reflect.Constructor<?> best = null;
                for (java.lang.reflect.Constructor<?> c : constructors) {
                    if (best == null || c.getParameterTypes().length > best.getParameterTypes().length) {
                        best = c;
                    }
                }
                if (best != null) {
                    best.setAccessible(true);
                    Object[] args = new Object[best.getParameterTypes().length];
                    Class<?>[] types = best.getParameterTypes();
                    for (int i = 0; i < types.length; i++) {
                        if (types[i] == java.awt.Dimension.class) args[i] = new java.awt.Dimension(100, 100);
                        else if (types[i] == boolean.class) args[i] = false;
                        else if (types[i] == int.class) args[i] = java.awt.image.BufferedImage.TYPE_INT_ARGB;
                        else if (types[i] == float.class) args[i] = 1.0f;
                        else if (types[i] == double.class) args[i] = 1.0;
                        else if (types[i] == long.class) args[i] = 0L;
                        else if (types[i] == short.class) args[i] = (short) 0;
                        else if (types[i] == byte.class) args[i] = (byte) 0;
                        else if (types[i] == char.class) args[i] = '\0';
                        else if (types[i] == java.util.List.class) args[i] = java.util.Collections.emptyList();
                        else if (types[i].getName().endsWith("ResizerFactory")) {
                            args[i] = net.coobird.thumbnailator.resizers.DefaultResizerFactory.getInstance();
                        }
                        else if (types[i].getName().endsWith("Resizer")) {
                            args[i] = new net.coobird.thumbnailator.resizers.ProgressiveBilinearResizer();
                        }
                        else args[i] = null;
                    }
                    param = (net.coobird.thumbnailator.ThumbnailParameter) best.newInstance(args);
                }
            } catch (Exception e) {
                throw new RuntimeException("Failed to create ThumbnailParameter for test setup", e);
            }

            // Instantiate a StreamThumbnailTask using the provided imageBytes as the destination
            java.io.ByteArrayInputStream is = new java.io.ByteArrayInputStream(new byte[0]);
            net.coobird.thumbnailator.tasks.StreamThumbnailTask task = new net.coobird.thumbnailator.tasks.StreamThumbnailTask(param, is, imageBytes);

            // Exercise the target API
            java.io.OutputStream dest = task.getDestination();

            // Verify the result matches the exact instance provided during construction
            assert dest != null : "Destination should not be null";
            assert dest == imageBytes : "Destination should match the provided OutputStream instance";

            System.out.println("__CHECK__ getDestination " + (dest == imageBytes));
            // TODO API_TEST_END
            System.out.println("__DONE__");
        } catch (Throwable exc) {
            System.err.println("__RUN_ERR__ " + exc.getClass().getSimpleName()
                    + ": " + exc.getMessage());
            exc.printStackTrace(System.err);
            System.exit(1);
        }
    }
}
